placeholder_policy.conservatism_note: Every placeholder is the maximum-length legal value for its field, so projected_object_bytes is an upper bound on the corresponding live receipt's serialized size, never an under-estimate. Semantic validator check #18 re-derives each placeholder's length against its field's maximum and fails if any placeholder is shorter.
